scripts.lint: bun run lint:js && bun run lint:rust
scripts.lint:rust: cargo clippy --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --check
scripts.copy:favicon: bun -e "import('node:fs/promises').then(({ mkdir }) => mkdir('dist', { recursive: true })).then(() => Bun.write('dist/favicon.ico', Bun.file('frontend/public/favicon.ico')))"
scripts.build: bun build ./frontend/js/main.js ./frontend/css/main.css --outdir ./dist/assets --target browser --minify && bun run copy:favicon
scripts.dev: bun run copy:favicon && bun build ./frontend/js/main.js ./frontend/css/main.css --outdir ./dist/assets --target browser --watch
